_about: Single source of truth for launcher settings. The backend (Launcher.ps1) validates and maps these to RECOMP_* environment variables; the UI (ui/app.js) renders them. To expose a new runtime option, add an entry here - no other code changes are needed. 'default' is what applies when the player has not changed anything; when 'env' also appears in tools/qpr2_runtime.psd1 (Runtime) the launcher shows that value as the default instead. A setting left at its default is NOT exported, so rebuild-and-run.ps1 and the runtime keep control of their own defaults.

settings.label: Raster worker threads
settings.help: Sets the total threads, including the caller, for CPU rasterization. Auto uses logical processors minus four, limited to 1–16. This setting does not control GPU work.

settings.label: GPU rasterizer
settings.help: Uses the validated D3D11 rasterizer when available. Off uses the CPU rasterizer. This controls game rendering independently of the Display presenter.

settings.label: Native GPU rasterizer (ROV)
settings.help: Allows native D3D11 rasterizer-ordered views after the startup checks. Off requests the compute rasterizer with CPU fallback.

settings.label: GPU vertex and triangle preparation
settings.help: Runs eligible vertex programs and triangle preparation on the GPU. Requires the native rasterizer, hardware coverage support and locally generated vertex programs. Unsupported draws keep their CPU path.

settings.label: Draw frustum checks
settings.help: Rejects supported draws proven to be outside the view and retains clipping for uncertain cases.

settings.label: Point-based GPU draw bounds
settings.help: Uses transformed points for eligible meshes of up to 256 vertices. Off uses the conservative box checks. This changes GPU geometry eligibility and clipping decisions.

settings.label: Partial GPU readback
settings.help: Copies the row span containing the dirty rectangle for eligible native render targets. Rows can include unchanged pixels. Off copies the whole surface.

settings.label: Queue target readbacks
settings.help: Keeps native target copies pending across eligible target switches. CPU consumers, fences and other dependencies can still force a wait.

settings.label: Reuse queued GPU surfaces
settings.help: Keeps the finished render buffer as the queued snapshot and draws into another buffer. This can skip a full GPU copy per eligible target switch.

settings.label: Defer queued surface copies
settings.help: Delays staging copies when a private GPU snapshot exists, so superseded copies can sometimes be skipped.

settings.label: Skip overwritten depth writes
settings.help: Benchmark candidate. A full depth-cache clear can skip publishing older queued depth writes. Color and visibility results still publish.

settings.label: Resume saved GPU targets
settings.help: Reuses a pending GPU snapshot when the target layout and CPU input match exactly. Ambiguous or changed targets use ordered readback.

settings.label: GPU fence completion markers
settings.help: Uses a small marker for eligible completion-only waits. Pixel consumers still get full publication. Debug GPU counters disable this path.

settings.label: Skip waits for read-only depth
settings.help: Skips some shared-depth waits when the previous target could not have changed depth. Off is the clean v1 baseline.

settings.label: Native vs. compute backend trial
settings.help: Benchmarks one eligible batch with both GPU rasterizers and may switch the session to compute. That batch can be unrepresentative of racing. Off is the clean v1 baseline.

settings.label: Window size
settings.help: Scales the initial window from the 640x480 guest framebuffer. The window shrinks to fit the work area. Guest render resolution stays at 640x480.

settings.label: Start fullscreen
settings.help: Borderless fullscreen with the picture letterboxed to its original 4:3. F11 or Alt+Enter toggles it in game.

settings.label: Monitor
settings.help: Which monitor the game window opens on. Auto uses your primary monitor.

settings.label: Direct3D 11 presenter
settings.help: Displays and scales the finished framebuffer with a D3D11 swap chain. Falls back to GDI if initialization fails. The game's rendering backend is controlled on the Performance page.

settings.label: V-Sync
settings.help: Synchronizes the D3D11 presenter to the display refresh. Off can allow tearing and retains the window loop's roughly 16 ms sleep. Guest rendering and simulation have separate timing.

settings.label: Picture filtering
settings.help: Smooth uses linear sampling when scaling the framebuffer. Sharp uses nearest-neighbor sampling to preserve pixel edges.

settings.label: Audio buffering
settings.help: Smaller buffers reduce delay but can crackle on a busy CPU. Balanced is the tested v126 setting; the others are untested.

settings.label: Final limiter
settings.help: A last-stage limiter that keeps loud moments from clipping. Default leaves the runtime's own choice in place.

settings.label: Positional stereo filter (HRTF)
settings.help: Optional stereo filter in the emulated audio processor. Default leaves the runtime's own choice in place.

settings.label: Keyboard input
settings.help: Lets the keyboard drive the game as well as a controller.

settings.label: Emulated Xbox controllers
settings.help: Presents your controllers to the game through the emulated USB bus. Leave on unless you are diagnosing input.

settings.label: Neutral controller fallback
settings.help: Keeps a neutral virtual pad connected so the game never stalls waiting for a controller.

settings.label: Vibration
settings.help: Passes the game's rumble to your controller.

settings.label: Left stick deadzone
settings.help: Ignores small movements of the left stick, on top of the game's own deadzone. Raise it if the stick drifts.

settings.label: Right stick deadzone
settings.help: The same for the right stick.

settings.label: Left stick response
settings.help: How the left stick ramps up. Smooth is gentler near the centre for finer control; Sharp reacts faster.

settings.label: Right stick response
settings.help: The same for the right stick.

settings.label: Trigger threshold
settings.help: How far a trigger must be pulled before it registers. The rest of the pull still reaches full strength.

settings.label: Invert left stick vertically
settings.help: Flips up and down on the left stick.

settings.label: Invert right stick vertically
settings.help: Flips up and down on the right stick, for example to invert the camera.

settings.label: Swap sticks
settings.help: The left stick does what the right stick did, and the other way round.

choices.label: Play
choices.note: Optimised build, normal logging, no time limit.

choices.label: Benchmark
choices.note: Full launch with timing counters and a memory map. Six-minute default limit.

choices.label: Debug
choices.note: Full launch with guest PC tracking, guest symbols and a memory map. Extra diagnostics affect FPS.

settings.label: Time limit
settings.help: Stops the game automatically after this long. Mode default means no limit for Play and six minutes for Benchmark and Debug.

settings.label: Build check on launch
settings.help: Quick can start an existing Play build. Benchmark and Debug always use a full launch so the build and diagnostic exports are current.

settings.label: Write logs immediately
settings.help: Slower, but keeps the last lines of the log if the game crashes early. Use when chasing a crash.

settings.label: Play music
settings.help: Plays the soundtrack from your local game files while you browse. It pauses when the game starts and resumes when you come back.

settings.label: Music volume
settings.help: Sets the volume of launcher music.

settings.label: Shuffle
settings.help: Plays the tracks in a random order without repeating one until all have played. Off plays them in order.

settings.label: Xbox ADPCM layout
settings.help: Only for tracks stored as Xbox ADPCM. Auto detects the layout. If music sounds buzzy or slightly slow, try the other two.

settings.label: Open fullscreen
settings.help: Starts the launcher fullscreen for the TV. F11 toggles it at any time.

settings.label: Skip launcher and play straight away
settings.help: Starts the game immediately. Hold Shift while starting to open the launcher.

settings.label: When the game starts
settings.help: Minimise brings the launcher back when the game exits.

settings.label: Back up saves before launch
settings.help: Zips the hdd folder before each launch, but only if something changed since the last backup.

settings.label: Automatic backups to keep
settings.help: Older automatic backups are removed. Manual backups are never removed.

settings.label: Button prompts
settings.help: Auto follows the controller you last used.

settings.label: Accent colour
settings.help: Auto picks a colour from your menu artwork.

settings.label: Interface size
settings.help: Make everything bigger for a distant TV, or smaller for a monitor.

settings.label: Menu sounds
settings.help: Soft clicks when moving around the launcher.

settings.label: Reduce motion
settings.help: Turns off background drift and slide animations.

settings.label: Download artwork automatically
settings.help: Fetches the logo and menu background once and keeps them in launcher/assets.
